description: This Dart source file defines the HomeActivity widget, which serves as the main navigation shell for a Flutter application. It manages a Scaffold with an AppBar and a Drawer containing various navigation options, and displays different fragments based on user selection. The code handles user profile display, drawer item selection, and initializes state with user info stored in preferences.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main widget representing the home activity, responsible for navigation and displaying various fragments based on drawer item selection.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class for HomeActivity, manages internal state such as selected drawer index, user info, and builds the UI.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state by setting user display name and email from passed parameters or stored preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree with a Scaffold, AppBar, Drawer, and body content based on current selection.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Builds the Drawer widget with header and menu items, handling user profile display and item selection.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on the selected drawer item.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Handles user interaction with drawer items, updating the selected index and closing the drawer.
